description: Ocean freight rerouted via an alternate port after berth congestion; three shipments arrived 6 to 9 days beyond quoted lead time.
Agreed load consolidation was not implemented; two orders shipped as partial loads and a third was air-freighted.
Proposed a housing redesign that removes one machining step; accepted by engineering.
No defects escaped on three consecutive lots.
Main machining line down for 9 days after a spindle failure; backlog of 14 orders.
Recovery plan missed because second-shift staffing was not in place; deliveries ran 5 to 12 days late.
Answered an engineering change notice in 2 days and proposed a tolerance change that cut part cost.
Notified a 6% price increase citing a raw material surcharge outside the contract index clause.
Requested a second surcharge without supporting index data.
Out-of-spec plating found on 3 lots; containment took 11 days.
Corrective action for the plating issue has been open 40 days with the root cause not verified.
Delivered a dedicated freight lane agreement that kept shipments within quoted lead time.
Quote and delivery-status requests went unanswered for 6 business days.
The delivery date for PO-0020 was never confirmed and buyer escalations went unanswered.
Held pricing flat through a steel index increase.
A design-change request took 14 days to answer; two builds waited on a drawing update.
A committed cost-down on fastener standardization slipped pending tooling approval.
Delivered every August order in full, including a 3-day expedite.
Answered nearly every request the same day.
Passed a contract-index price decrease through ahead of schedule.
Three September orders shipped 7 to 10 percent above the PO quantity; receiving held the excess pending a planning decision.
Two shipments ran 4 days late after a carrier capacity shortfall.
No defective parts shipped in the quarter.
Resolved all open buyer requests within the agreed response time.
Closed corrective actions faster than in any quarter this year.
Met all committed ship dates on a rush build.
Shipped on time through a port slowdown.
Offered volume-tier pricing without being asked.
One late shipment of corrugated cartons; resolved within a week.
